decision: Capture the same hypothetical entire-field postcondition for an exact owned single word plus Space, whether UserInput or already AuthorizedEdit. UserInput must equal the live composition, not an arbitrary replacement. No observed empty field or KnownStart is invented. The later entire field, end caret, no selection, owner, epoch and deadline must still match before ASCII-Space/NBSP acknowledgement. Known or partial starts retain their original strict checks. Output order, ManualToggleV3/VisibleTailV4, daemon detector and execution routes remain unchanged.

consequence_analysis.candidate_retention_ranking_false_author: No lexical candidate generation, ranking or projection change. UserInput equality and a single nonempty word are required; hypothetical expected text grants no edit authority before a later exact receipt. Main risk is adopting an unrelated field, bounded by whole-field and existing context-owner gates plus negative tests.
consequence_analysis.latency_cpu_rss: No RPC, wait, retry, worker, timer or deadline change. Reuses existing one-word allocation and pending postcondition. Newly eligible ordinary commits retain one small expected-field string until existing acknowledgement or expiry.
consequence_analysis.cache_identity_invalidation_packages: No new cache or model/package dependency. Existing owner/epoch/deadline and surrounding revision invalidation remain authoritative. Source closure and installed artifact hashes identify proof.
consequence_analysis.learning_feedback: No correction or acceptance feedback is added. Exact ordinary Space acknowledgement remains feedback-free and cannot train lexical data.
consequence_analysis.concurrency_stale_results: No new owner or route. Stale epoch, foreign owner, expired receipt, selection, changed prefix/word, extra boundary and moved caret remain refusals; delayed callbacks cannot become pre-dispatch evidence.
consequence_analysis.failure_rollback: CommitText failure cannot arm the postcondition. A nonmatching receipt leaves the tail unconfirmed as before. Revert only this eligibility extension if native receipt contradicts hypothesis; retain prior Tab fix.
consequence_analysis.compatibility_maintenance: Common managed-preedit mechanism, no Firefox/KDE or word-specific runtime condition. Terminal passthrough, atomic, sensitive and exact-refresh routes remain excluded from the new no-snapshot branch. Reuse one helper and existing verifier; no second source of truth.
consequence_analysis.second_order_risks: A future producer passing multiword text must be rejected, not acknowledged by this helper. Existing observed-start path must not fall through when stale. Package updates cannot relax these context requirements. Appearance and rapid-gesture latency remain separate failures.
